verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Payroll documents its own ability to customize, run, print, or export payroll reports (docs-18), which is a thin first-party export path. Nothing shows a complete account export, open file formats, or an offboarding path. The Workforce API that reads employee info and payslips is a developer building block rather than an export feature, and the migration help (docs-20) covers moving data in, not out. Missing for 10: documented full-account data export, named open formats (CSV/JSON), coverage of all data types (employee documents, tax filings, timesheets), an exit/offboarding process, and independent corroboration.
